metadata.description: Key academic deadlines for UMN Twin Cities graduate students. Dates are APPROXIMATE and term-specific. Always verify at onestop.umn.edu/calendar for the current term.
metadata.warning: NEVER cite these as authoritative dates without directing the student to verify at the canonical URL. Dates change every term.

verification_instruction: For any deadline question, ALWAYS include: 'Verify the exact date for your term at https://onestop.umn.edu/calendar'

process_deadlines.label: Registration Opens (by appointment time)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: ~4 weeks before term start for continuing students
process_deadlines.notes: Appointment times are assigned by credit count. Check MyU for your specific time.

process_deadlines.label: Add a Class
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Through the end of the second week of the term (100% tuition liability begins earlier)
process_deadlines.notes: After the second week, requires instructor and department approval. Self-service add closes earlier.

process_deadlines.label: Drop a Class – Full Tuition Credit
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Through the end of the first week of the term
process_deadlines.notes: Dropping before this date results in no tuition charge for the course.

process_deadlines.label: Drop a Class – No 'W' on Record
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Through the end of the second week of the term (check specific date)
process_deadlines.notes: After this date, a 'W' (Withdrawal) appears on the transcript.

process_deadlines.label: Drop a Class – 'W' on Record (Late Drop)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Between end of week 2 and end of week 10 (approximate)
process_deadlines.notes: Requires instructor approval after week 2. After the late-drop deadline, withdrawal from the full term may be required.

process_deadlines.label: Change Grade Basis (A-F to S/N)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Through the end of the second week of the term
process_deadlines.notes: Graduate students should be cautious about S/N basis — many programs require A-F for degree-applicable courses.

process_deadlines.label: Apply to Graduate (Degree Completion Intent)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Typically the first month of the intended graduation term. For May graduation: ~January deadline.
process_deadlines.notes: Graduate students must submit their 'month of intended graduation' via MyU. Separate from the GPAS audit.

process_deadlines.label: CS Degree Program Form (Plan of Study) Submission
process_deadlines.typical_timing: By end of first semester of enrollment (CS handbook requirement)
process_deadlines.notes: CS-specific. Must list all planned courses and be signed by advisor and DGS. Contact csgradmn@umn.edu.

process_deadlines.label: Thesis / Dissertation Submission to Grad School
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Varies; typically 2–4 weeks before degree conferral date
process_deadlines.notes: Electronic submission via ETD system. Requires formatting review. Allow extra time for revisions.

process_deadlines.label: Doctoral Oral Exam Scheduling
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Must give at least 2 weeks advance notice to Grad School
process_deadlines.notes: Committee must be submitted to Grad School before scheduling. Contact cs_grad and grad_school.

process_deadlines.label: Tuition Payment Deadline
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Typically mid-to-late month in the first month of the term
process_deadlines.notes: Late payment results in a financial hold and late fee. RA/TA tuition benefit timing may differ.

process_deadlines.label: Financial Aid Disbursement
process_deadlines.typical_timing: First week of term (after enrollment is confirmed)
process_deadlines.notes: Aid is credited to student account. Requires enrollment at aid-eligible credit level.

process_deadlines.label: CSCI 8970 Colloquium Enrollment
process_deadlines.typical_timing: By end of add deadline for the term
process_deadlines.notes: CS-specific requirement. Must be enrolled in 8970 each semester in residence (check handbook for exceptions).

process_deadlines.label: CPT Application Lead Time (ISSS)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Submit to ISSS at least 3–4 weeks BEFORE employment start date
process_deadlines.notes: CRITICAL: Allow extra time for ISSS processing. Course enrollment for CPT must come first. Contact ISSS early.

process_deadlines.label: OPT Application Lead Time (ISSS + USCIS)
process_deadlines.typical_timing: Apply to USCIS up to 90 days before program end date; USCIS processing ~3–5 months
process_deadlines.notes: CRITICAL: Apply EARLY. USCIS processing takes months. Contact ISSS as soon as timeline is known.
